upstreams.role: Pinned retrieval, MCP and graph projection runtime; not the unmodified ATLAS canonical write store.
notes: Use Postgres/pgvector for remote MCP; PGLite remains local-only.
Existing source_id isolation is useful but does not satisfy ATLAS project_id, RLS, proposal, and publish-role requirements by itself.
Initialize explicitly with ollama:bge-m3 and 1024 dimensions after ATLAS-16 pins the model digest.

upstreams.role: Evaluation harness for the private ATLAS gold corpus and regression adapter.
notes: The archive depends on github:garrytan/gbrain#master and must be patched to the pinned gbrain commit before use.
Published benchmark values are not ATLAS acceptance evidence.

upstreams.role: Reference for adapter discovery, normalization and staging patterns.
notes: Raw agent transcripts are excluded from ATLAS V1.
Its redaction-first behavior must not replace ATLAS quarantine-and-review rules.
No bridge source is copied into the foundation.

upstreams.role: Optional external Obsidian client capability; never the canonical embedding index.
notes: The supplied archive is not standalone and references multiple local file dependencies.
Using its separate embeddings as canonical data would create index drift.
License and product-distribution implications require explicit approval.

upstreams.role: Optional external Obsidian presentation and canvas enhancement.
notes: Do not vendor or derive core ATLAS code from this plugin without an explicit GPL distribution decision.
Configuration-only use in a local Obsidian profile may be evaluated separately.
